git_scope: Full clone; the named files at the pinned commit for issues #583 and #586, the head of master when retrieved. Four commits follow 0fa0e0d, the issue-561 pin: 93570ef changes 176, 344, 375 and 378; 4596670, the #583 pin, adds 154, 211, 302 and 382 and changes 241, 339, 375, 376, 378, 379, 380 and 381; 06d8db2 changes no certificate; b85dee2, the #586 pin, changes 154, 211, 241, 339, 344, 378, 379, 380 and 382. Against 0fa0e0d that is four certificates added and ten changed, and those 14 are retained as factual data. The other 59 certificates the commit holds are unchanged and pinned by digest against the copies the issue-476, issue-488, issue-506 and issue-561 packets retain. The two READMEs, the per-certificate JSON metadata and the 14 changed decimal pose files are pinned by digest only. The rest of the tree, including the drawings and the search programs, is pinned by the commit and was not retained or executed.
license: No licence file or reuse terms at the pin: the tree has no LICENSE, and neither README.md nor certificates/README.md states terms. The changed certificates are retained as factual data under the owner decision of 2026-10-09 recorded in resources/web/known-best-packings/README.md (Retained Factual Data); prose is hash-pinned and not copied. certificates/README.md credits Evan Daniel's MIT-licensed exact contact solver, which does not license this bundle.
claims: Issue #586 reports s(154) <= 12.921206577133, an exact optimum from Evan Daniel's exact contact solver, and precision refinements s(211) <= 14.993558913975 and s(241) <= 15.987117095151 of the arrangements #583 reported, each its certificate's exact side rounded up to 12 places.
Issue #583 reports s(302) <= 17.870013850405, an exact optimum from the same solver, unchanged at this commit.

Issues #583 and #586 report five certificates beyond the n <= 324 case corpus, for the beyond-horizon list: 339, 379, 380 and 382 at this commit (#586), rational witnesses with centre dilations 1 + 1e-11 at 339 and 1 + 1e-12 at the others, and 381 (#583), an exact optimum, unchanged at this commit.

Five further certificates changed since 0fa0e0d are named by no issue, each with its exact side and its side rounded up to 12 places in certificates/README.md: 176 in the case corpus, and 344, 375, 376 and 378 beyond it.
The checker statements (this repository's sqpack verify.py at 562fdbd and Evan Daniel's verify_cert.py at 31523f8) are the author's; no optimality claim is made.
